description: Hyperliquid public REST candleSnapshot for BTC/ETH/SOL perpetuals (daily bars)
permission_basis: Public market data served without authentication by Hyperliquid's public /info endpoint (candleSnapshot), used for research only; raw payloads are not redistributed. Hyperliquid Terms of Service reviewed 2026-11-18. This registry entry is an explicit research-use assertion, not a legal determination.
timestamp_basis: Exchange event time: candle open time in UTC milliseconds; a candle's values become knowable at its close (open + bar duration). Daily bars open at 00:00 UTC.
